name: Financial Assistance for Natural Disaster
benefit: Under this scheme, in case of any loss due to a natural calamity, financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- is sanctioned by the Tehsildar, up to ₹50,000/- by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, and above ₹50,000/- by the District Magistrate.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant or their family must have been affected by a natural disaster.
